# Ping-pong loop of the leads chart

A 2.6 s moment from the motion promo, where the leads chart opens and its bars grow, turned into a seamless ping-pong loop: it plays forward, then backward, so the last frame flows straight back into the first with no jump.

- Type: Seamless loop
- Skill: `magnifito-edit`
- Engine: `loop`
- Output: 1920x1080, 5.13 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/f06-seamless-loop.mp4`](../videos/f06-seamless-loop.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Take the leads chart moment from ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 (6.9 s to 9.5 s, where the pill opens into the chart card and the bars grow) and turn it into a seamless loop for a website hero background and a looping social post. Use a forward-then-reverse ping-pong so there is no jump at the seam, with no repeated frame at either turn.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- f06-seamless-loop
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/f06-seamless-loop/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
ffmpeg -ss 6.9 -t 2.6 -i ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/moment.mp4
mgvideo loop work/moment.mp4 --out work/loop.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/loop.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
